headline: Three more tankers reportedly 'hit mines' in Hormuz, according to Iran
summary: Iran's naval force of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed that three more tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, adding to earlier reported incidents.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of seaborne oil exports from the Gulf passes, so disruptions there directly affect global crude supply and shipping costs.
why_moved: Claimed mine strikes on additional tankers in the Strait of Hormuz increase the risk of disrupted Gulf crude shipments, which typically supports oil prices.
